approved_delicate_scopes.detail: Tilted partition proof correctly treats the three Laplace derivative estimates as hypotheses/analytic input, obtains upper/lower leading exponential constant and avoids asserting an unproved local-density prefactor.
Graded-Lie signs, cocycle condition and exact central finite model are consistent; the polynomial Maurer-Cartan series cancels at every order in that model.
Both ideal-containment directions and the sole S-pair reduction are correct; standard monomial dimension is three.

Corrects homology/Pontryagin versus cohomology/cup confusion. The degree-one integral cup square vanishes by graded commutativity and torsion freeness. Exterior-degree-one times divided-power-degree-two ring is classical input, explicitly not proved from one spectral-sequence arrow. The finite Z/4 versus(Z/2)^2 extension witness is exact.

findings.description: The stated Lyapunov theorem and rational P calculation are correct, but the chosen A has negative-definite Euclidean symmetric part already. It therefore does not itself illustrate the title’s phrase about Euclidean symmetric-part failure.
findings.fix: Optionally shorten the title, or supply a separately checked more nonnormal example. No change to the valid theorem is required.
findings.resolution: Author replaced the example by A=[[-1,3],[0,-1]], P=[[1/2,3/4],[3/4,11/4]]. Reviewer confirmed A^T P+PA=−I, detP13/16, det(3I−P)1/16, alpha1/6, robustness1/15 and the positive Euclidean growth direction(1,1). Supplied verifier rerun34/34pass.
